stem.text: The diagrams show three rigid objects P, Q and R being subjected to different combinations of forces.

stem.alt: Diagram of rigid object P, a grey rectangle with four horizontal forces. Printed labels: 10 N and 20 N acting to the left, 20 N and 10 N acting to the right.
Diagram of rigid object Q, a square with dashed diagonals and four diagonal forces. Printed labels: 80 N (top left), 80 N (top right), 60 N (bottom left), 60 N (bottom right).
Diagram of rigid object R, a grey square with two forces of 50 N on its upper sides, each at a printed angle of 30 degrees, and a downward force of 100 N.
